subject: Zephyr pilot overage: offset request & accounting next steps
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Zephyr Health Accounting <acct@zephyrhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot overage offset + short extension

Hi Aditya,

Quick note from our side — the Zephyr POC ran ~40% higher than expected last month due to an expanded ingest window while the analytics team validated an integration. That pushed us over the pilot allowance and we just received an invoice for $34,650.

We're hoping Redwood can provide a credit memo to offset this invoice (so it doesn't hit our month-end accruals) and a 30-day extension on the pilot period while we complete the final validation. The engineering team expects no further surges after the fix next week.

I've attached our usage export for the pilot window so you can see the spike. If a credit memo isn't the right play for accounting reasons, let me know the alternative — we can accept an invoice-level offset or a one-time promo credit applied to our ledger.

Thanks — Sophie
(Attachment: usage_report_may2028.csv)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot overage offset + short extension

Sophie — thanks for the heads up and the usage file. I've looped in Laura and Lauren from finance and Marcus from billing so we can align on the best accounting path.

Two quick clarifying Qs from our side:
- Is Zephyr OK with Redwood issuing a formal credit memo tied to the invoice number, or do you prefer we apply an invoice offset in your AR system?
- Do you have a PO number we should reference on the credit memo?

Provisional plan:
- Finance to advise on G/L mapping and whether contra-revenue is required vs. an allowance.
- Billing to prepare a draft credit memo for your review (we'll include the usage snippet and link to the original invoice).
- Once you confirm, we'll send the credit memo via DocuSign (if you prefer) and process the pilot extension in the console.

I'll attach a preliminary credit memo draft so you can see the format.

Thanks — Aditya
(Attachment: credit_memo_proposal_ZH-47.pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@zephyrhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot overage offset + short extension

Thanks for pulling this together. From an accounting standpoint we recommend issuing a credit memo that posts as an allowance (not immediate contra-revenue) so Zephyr can net it against the specific invoice for month-end without recognizing a refund. Suggested GL mapping:
- Credit memo (liability reduction): GLA 2301
- Allowance account for credits: GLA 4802
- If Zephyr requires contra-revenue posting, use GLA 5802 but note this will affect revenue KPIs for the period.

Requirements for our team to proceed:
1) Confirm PO or invoice number to reference on the credit memo.
2) Written acceptance from Zephyr approving the dollar amount and that they want it treated as an offset to the invoice.
3) Billing to attach the usage detail to the credit memo PDF.

I've added a short spreadsheet with journal entry examples and the suggested posting date (we recommend booking in the same period as the original invoice to keep revenue recognition aligned).

Thanks — Lauren
(Attachment: accounting_notes.xlsx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@zephyrhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 May 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot overage offset + short extension

We can accommodate either approach. Practical considerations:
- Credit memo route: we will generate a signed PDF (credit_memo_proposal_ZH-47.pdf), include the usage CSV as supporting evidence, and post a memo to the AR balance. Zephyr will be able to apply it to invoice INV-20280503 or take a cash refund if requested.
- Invoice offset route: requires a corresponding journal entry on our side and an explicit request from Zephyr to net this in their AR system; we'll need the exact invoice number(s).

If Zephyr is comfortable with the credit memo, we'll issue it and route to DocuSign. Timeline: 3 business days after final approval to issue and 24 hours to reflect in their AR once applied.

Let me know which invoice to reference; if we don't hear back by EOD Friday (19 May), we'll prepare the credit memo for INV-20280503 by default.

— Marcus
(Attachment referenced: credit_memo_proposal_ZH-47.pdf)

From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@zephyrhealth.com>

Hi team — thanks for the clear options. Zephyr confirms the following:
- Approve a credit memo for $34,650 to offset invoice INV-20280503.

- We also accept the 30-day pilot extension; please apply it to the existing trial window and share the console link with our PM so they can resume validation.

Sophie (on behalf of Zephyr Accounting)
